title: Evidence map: NS1 inhibition of IFN-β-induced STAT phosphorylation

cells.text:
NS1 downregulates IFNAR1,
blocks IFN-β response
[ns1_ifnar1_heLa_2024]

293T screen: NS1 effects on
IFN-α/β-regulated genes
[ns1_34gene_microarray_293T_2009]

note_box:
no avian-cell or wild-bird pSTAT data anywhere in the corpus —
the phosphorylation step specifically is untested beyond human lines
caption: NS1–IFN antagonism is documented in human cell lines (IFNAR1 downregulation in HeLa; a 34-gene NS1 screen in 293T), but STAT phosphorylation itself and any avian/wild-bird context are absent.
